tools.name: latest_moves
tools.description: What moved in Indian retail, newest first: store openings, funding and deals, results, launches and pricing, leadership, strategy and regulation. Filter by brand, theme or kind of move. Each item: headline, the move in one figure, IST date, brands, a one-sentence read, the original outlet with its l

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: The full RetailIntel read of one move in Indian retail: what happened, why it matters, what to watch next, key facts, the original outlet and link. Pass the slug or the retailintel.in/signal/… URL from another tool.

tools.name: brand_profile
tools.description: One Indian retail brand at a glance: how many moves in the last 30 days against the 30 before, by kind (stores, deals, results…), cities of its store moves, brands it is reported with, and its latest moves with sources. Accepts a name or slug.

tools.name: compare_brands
tools.description: Competitors side by side: moves about each brand in the window against the window before, by kind, with each brand's latest moves and the biggest difference in one line. Without a key or on a free key: up to 5 brands over 7 days. Pro keys: up to 25 brands over 7, 30, 90 days.

tools.name: daily_brief
tools.description: RetailIntel's morning brief: the day's most widely reported moves in Indian retail, each with why it matters and what to watch, as sent by email at 07:30 IST. Pass brands and/or themes for the newest reports on just those.

tools.name: get_expansion_map
tools.description: Store openings in one Indian city or shopping centre over the last 180 days, from the RetailIntel store-opening tracker: the lead, key numbers (openings, how many at a named mall, brand firsts, announced plans), openings by category (fashion, F&B, jewellery & watches…), the charts on the page as fig

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: An Indian retail or consumer group at a glance (Tata, Reliance, Aditya Birla, Avenue Supermarts/DMart, Eternal, Walmart/Flipkart, HUL, ITC …): the verdict on its businesses' newest results season and how many more are due, the revenue-growth chart by business (structuredContent.chartHtml, each figur

tools.name: get_leadership_moves
tools.description: Senior hires, promotions and exits at Indian retail and consumer companies, from the RetailIntel leadership tracker (retailintel.in/people): the last 7 days' count against the 7 before, RetailIntel's written read for the reader's role, the moves that matter to that role, announced moves not yet in e

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Indian retail brands, themes and moves by name or words, e.g. "Croma", "quick commerce funding", "Trent Zudio stores". Returns JSON {results:[{id,title,url,text}]}; pass an id to fetch for the full read, or a brand to brand_profile.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one result from search: a move (signal:<slug>), a brand (brand:<slug>) or a theme (theme:<slug>), or any retailintel.in signal/brand/theme URL. Returns JSON {id,title,text,url,metadata}.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signal, get_expansion_map, get_group, get_leadership_moves, search, fetch · Public sink: daily_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signal, get_expansion_map, get_group, get_leadership_moves, search, fetch · Public sink: daily_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
